description: This file defines helper functions for network configuration in an iOS app, including parsing host and port strings and constructing HTTP URLs.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string to extract host and port information, handling IPv6 addresses encased in brackets, and returns a SettingsHostPort object if successful.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string given optional host and port parameters, or returns a fallback URL if either is missing.
